chat_messages.text: Hey, my name is Jane Sample and I'm based in Austin, TX. I run a small agency called WidgetWorks. You can reach me at jane.sample@example.com.
Got it, nice to meet you Jane. How can I help with WidgetWorks today?
From now on, please don't use emojis in your responses, and always format code blocks with the language tag. I hate when responses are padded with fluff.
We're building a SaaS called Proteum for scheduling. It's hosted on Vercel with a Supabase backend, still in early beta.
Random note: my dog Biscuit turned 5 this week. Also my daughter is 9 years old and loves robotics.
That's lovely to hear! Robotics at 9 is a great start.
